Metadata.Goal: 建立独立、transport-neutral 的 Domain Operation catalog 与 execute JSON contract。
Metadata.Description: 实现五维 Operation DTO、single/selection/batch request、response outcome/effects/observations/trace/diagnostics、unknown-input validation 与 catalog consistency tests。

TaskSpace.name: add-domain-operation-contracts
TaskSpace.Description: 用测试先行方式建立 request/catalog 与 response/diagnostics 两个 contract slice。

TaskGroup.name: Operation catalog 与 request contract
TaskGroup.Description: 先固定 request 代表性行为，再实现五维 DTO、subject/invocation union、unknown-input parser 与 JSON roundtrip。

Task.name: 编写 request contract 失败测试与 package scaffold
Task.Description: 按 behavior request/catalog cases 创建 package scaffold 和 request-contracts.test.ts；覆盖五维 literal、api/bundle version 分离、single、selection、batch、duplicate key、unknown JSON path issue 与 JSON roundtrip。测试应因公共实现尚缺失而失败，不能因测试语法或环境错误失败。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: package scaffold 符合现有 ESM、strict TypeScript 与 declaration build 约定
request tests 覆盖五维、single/selection/batch 消歧、invalid input 和 roundtrip
测试以缺少最小 contract 实现的预期原因失败

Task.name: 实现 catalog、request DTO 与 unknown-input validation
Task.Description: 实现 JSON value、DomainContext catalog、Operation definition、subject selector、single/batch invocation、execute request、structured validation issue/error 与 parser，使 T1.1 tests 通过；禁止 framework/database/runtime 依赖。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 公开 DTO 精确表达五维 Operation 与独立 atomicity
parseExecuteOperationRequest 对合法 fixtures roundtrip，对 malformed/empty/duplicate batch 返回 path-aware issues
request contract focused tests 全部通过且 package 无 runtime dependency

TaskGroup.name: Response、catalog compatibility 与 package integration
TaskGroup.Description: 先固定 response 与 mismatch 行为，再实现 outcome/effects/observations/trace/diagnostics、纯 catalog consistency validation 和构建集成。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: bun run --filter depa-data-domain-operation-contracts build 通过

Task.name: 编写 response 与 catalog compatibility 失败测试
Task.Description: 创建 response-contracts.test.ts；覆盖七种 outcome、effects/observations/trace/diagnostics JSON roundtrip、catalog dimension/context/invocation mismatch、稳定 capability codes、batch/SQL unavailable 不伪造结果。测试应因实现尚缺失而失败。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: tests 覆盖 catalog mismatch 与稳定 capability diagnostic codes
测试以缺少最小 response/compatibility 实现的预期原因失败

Task.name: 实现 response contract、compatibility validation 与构建集成
Task.Description: 实现 response outcome/effects/observations/trace/diagnostics DTO、stable code exports、validateOperationCatalogMatch 纯校验与 representative fixtures；补 package 公共入口和 root build 集成，运行 focused tests、declaration build 和 root build。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 七种 outcome 与完整 response envelope 可 JSON roundtrip
catalog mismatch 返回 OPERATION_CATALOG_MISMATCH path-aware issues，且不包含 runtime 执行
不可用 mapping/SQL/atomic capability 由稳定 diagnostics 表达而不伪造数据
focused tests、package declaration build 与 root build 全部通过
package 不依赖或导入 web-shared、Vue、Elysia、SQLite、Kon、depa-orm 或 depa-orm-capsule
